move: three lighten-blend photos drift and breathe inside a dark silhouette
how: A black SVG head-and-shoulders silhouette on white, covered by three full-frame images with mix-blend-mode lighten and heavy contrast filters; over white lighten is white, over the dark silhouette the image shows, giving the double exposure. Each layer moves x/y 12 to 50px, scales 1.04 to 1.15 and breathes opacity on sines of the loop phase (every term a whole cycle), and the silhouette bobs 6px and scales 1%. All values are set from t in a seek function via gsap.set.
adapt: Replace the silhouette path and the three images (high-contrast landscapes work best), the caption and tag; keep whole-cycle sine terms so the 2s loop closes.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the silhouette SVG and the .ex image layers; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one {t:0->D, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) gsap.set calls. Scope '.ex1..3' and '.silhouette' to el.
caveats: three full-frame images with filter contrast/saturate and mix-blend-mode are costly to composite
